summary: Frontend-only validation of the new A4FitWrapper auto-shrink mechanism for the 3 bulletin templates (Simple / BTS Blanc / Combiné) on Master Digital Marketing 2026, student Bernard Lucas. ALL acceptance criteria pass. The A4FitWrapper.tsx module exists at /app/src/components/grades/A4FitWrapper.tsx with a `export default A4FitWrapper`. The 3 templates correctly import it: SimpleBulletinTemplate.tsx (line 2), BtsBlancBulletinTemplate.tsx (line 2), CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx (line 2). For all 3 periods (Semestre 1 → simple-bulletin, BTS Blanc → bts-blanc-bulletin, Bulletin bts → combined-bulletin) the outer wrapper is measured live at width=793.688px / height=1122.52px / padding=37.7953px / overflow=hidden — exact A4 portrait at 96 DPI (210mm × 297mm with 10mm padding). The data-a4-scale attribute is present on every wrapper and contains a numeric value '1.000' for Bernard Lucas, which is the EXPECTED value per the main-agent context note (3, 6 and 3 modules respectively → innerScrollHeight 496/445/576 px, well below the 1047 px / 277 mm threshold, so no scaling kicks in). The inner div correctly carries width:190mm / transform:none when scale=1. NO ResizeObserver loop error was observed in the console across all 3 dialogs (the 2-pass measurement strategy is stable). NO runtime error was introduced ('is not defined', ReferenceError, pageerror are all absent). Visually, all 3 bulletins render entirely inside the A4 frame (header + identity block + notes/épreuves table + Assiduité/Appréciation/Directeur boxes) with no clipping at the bottom. The only console errors are pre-existing and unrelated: (1) Radix UI 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' a11y warning (already flagged in iter 56/57), (2) Supabase Edge Function compute-bulletin CORS/404/400 (already flagged in iter 55-57; client-side fallback works). Overflow case (scale<1) could not be reproduced because no seeded student has >12 modules — this is documented and acceptable as the agent context explicitly stated.

issues: Pre-existing a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' for screen readers — wrap title in VisuallyHidden. NOT a blocker, NOT a regression of this iteration.

Pre-existing French typos still present: 'DIERECTEUR DE L'ETABLISSEMENT' (should be DIRECTEUR), '(nom, prenom, signature et cachet de letablissement)' (missing accents/apostrophes). Cosmetic, carried from iter 56/57.

action_items: NONE BLOCKING. The auto-shrink A4FitWrapper is correctly wired on the 3 templates, exposes data-a4-scale (numeric, 1.000 for Bernard Lucas as expected), wrappers have exact 210×297mm dimensions with overflow:hidden, no ResizeObserver loop, no runtime error. ✓
If you want to actively verify the scale<1 path in QA, seed a test student with >12 modules on a single period (or temporarily lower TARGET_H_MM to force overflow). Not required for shipping.

critical_code_review_comments: A4FitWrapper.tsx — clean, correct logic: useLayoutEffect runs measureAndScale on mount/children change; ResizeObserver re-runs on resize; image load listeners re-run after async logo loads. Inner width compensation (CONTENT_W_MM / scale) preserves visual fill at any scale. MIN_SCALE=0.4 floor prevents illegible 11pt+ output. ✓

A4FitWrapper.tsx:38-50 — measureAndScale uses a 2-pass strategy: pass 1 measures at natural width, pass 2 re-measures at the compensated width and tightens the scale if needed. The if-guard `if (h2 > TARGET_H_PX) s = TARGET_H_PX / h2;` means scale is only ever decreased between passes — this guarantees no oscillation and avoids the classic ResizeObserver loop. Confirmed empirically: 0 RO loop errors observed across 3 dialogs. ✓

A4FitWrapper.tsx:34-51 — minor: measureAndScale mutates el.style.transform/width directly before calling setState. This is intentional (immediate measurement) but could surprise React DevTools users; consider a comment. Non-blocking.
A4FitWrapper.tsx:88 — data-a4-scale={scale.toFixed(3)} exposed correctly on outer wrapper for testing. Verified live: '1.000' on all 3 bulletins for Bernard Lucas. ✓
All 3 templates correctly import from './A4FitWrapper' (relative path, default import). ✓

Edge case to monitor (low priority): with `overflow: hidden` and MIN_SCALE=0.4, content larger than ~2.5× A4 height would still be clipped after scaling to 0.4. For real bulletins this would require >25 modules — extremely unlikely. Consider adding a dev-time console.warn when computed scale === MIN_SCALE.
useLayoutEffect dependency array contains [children] only — eslint-disable-next-line is justified. ✓
ResizeObserver is created/disconnected correctly in cleanup; image load listeners are removed on unmount. No leak. ✓
